name: Cuckoo
description: Cuckoo is a card game in which each player is dealt one card and may exchange it with the next player; the aim is to avoid holding the lowest card and losing a life. Last player left in wins. Also known as Chase the Ace and Ranter Go Round (Britain), Screw Your Neighbor (USA).

overview.description: Cuckoo is a card game in which each player is dealt one card and may exchange it with the next player; the aim is to avoid holding the lowest card and losing a life. Last player left in wins. Also known as Chase the Ace and Ranter Go Round (Britain), Screw Your Neighbor (USA).

history.origins:
Country/Region of Origin: England and France. The English variant (Ranter Go Round, Chase the Ace) is a traditional English game, said to have been first played in Cornwall; documented from 1881 (Cassell's). A similar game known as Cuckoo in most European countries originated in 16th-century France and developed into the French game Coucou.
Time Period: 16th century (France); 19th century (England)
Historical Development: French Coucou lineage; English Ranter Go Round described by 1881, with scoring variants (e.g. Professor Hoffmann 1891).
Cultural Significance: Popular social and family game in Britain (as Ranter Go Round/Chase the Ace) and USA (as Screw Your Neighbor); Cuckoo group played across Europe.
timeline: Modern Era: Continues to be played worldwide
